expected_equivalences.basis: The production and legacy reproducer trees are identical at these two commits; the installed executable SHA-256 must still confirm the equivalence.
The two lifecycle-test commits do not change the server production tree from dominant-family-ranking; the installed executable SHA-256 must still confirm the equivalence.

binary_deduplication.identity_field: installed server executable SHA-256 for aliases; behavioral runtime identity SHA-256 for performance pooling
binary_deduplication.policy: An identical installed server executable SHA-256 makes commit/build labels executable aliases, so aliases are never presented as independent binaries. Performance rows may be pooled only when the content-derived direct-linked runtime closure and live backend-module closure also produce the same behavioral runtime identity SHA-256; that identity hashes runtime_closure_sha256 plus backend_runtime_closure_sha256. Preserve RPM ownership, NEVRA, build ID, and every commit/build label as provenance. Only an exact 40-hex package source token independently proves the asserted revision; a short git prefix is corroboration plus an operator assertion, and a source-tree expectation is not a measured identity.
